business_problem: Black Eyewear wanted to capture elite styling expertise in AI so customers could get personalized eyewear recommendations and aspirational virtual try-ons without a long custom R&D cycle or a hard handoff between creatives and engineers.
solution_summary: Black Eyewear uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: Black Eyewear wanted to capture elite styling expertise in AI so customers could get personalized eyewear recommendations and aspirational virtual try-ons without a long custom R&D cycle or a hard handoff between creatives and engineers. Vertex AI Vision labels images and trains specialist models that evaluate facial structure and frame geometry, serving as the compute layer. Gemini Flash powers the conversational frame agent that interprets customer preferences and replicates Robert Roope’s styling voice, serving as the serving layer. Nano Banana 2 generates branded virtual try-on images from customer photos in seconds, serving as the compute layer. Gemini provides the multimodal reasoning layer that unifies vision, language, and recommendation logic, serving as the compute layer.

data_flow: Customer preferences and uploaded photos enter the frame agent, Vertex AI Vision-derived models analyze facial geometry, Gemini Flash maps style cues into recommendations, and Nano Banana 2 renders branded try-on imagery for the shopper.
